validation.evidence: Parent confirmed targeted exit0; independently read complete source and all seven standard-axiom exports. No reviewer build.

checks: ready derives root Journal from actual checkpoint balance/nonce update, preserving code and persistent storage. Actual entrySubstate starts from A0 and changes access sets only, so protected deletion exclusion is derived empty rather than assumed.

Root request is literal transaction creation or message selector. Creation needs only the checkpoint journal; message coherence uses exact target and toExecute at checkpoint plus installed CodeAt. Actual and apparent values are definitionally equal.

adequate uses exact request_gas and request fuel identity with 5*(entryGas.toNat+1)<=c.fuel; no EVM-gas sufficiency claim. data_fit handles actual message data and needs no creation-root Theta width premise.

provisional inverts both exact Context.provisional branches, preserving world/gas/substate/status and supplying only erased address/created/output witnesses. It applies Done to actual Lambda/Theta result, including false status.

settled unfolds exact TransactionFunding.result_equation for actual Upsilon, rejects provisional error under actual completed result, then derives protected frame through refund credit, optional beneficiary payment and actual cleanup. Nonempty code and deletion exclusion come from provisional Journal, not supplied postconditions. Final substate is the actual unchanged provisional tuple field; cleanup modifies world.

completed obtains the same actual certified tree and tree.count<=used from transaction_events using the actual Upsilon receipt. Funding inputs derive via linked FundingHistory and root data fit. Whole-event bound follows budget+used, then JournalCheckpoints.from_resources derives final provisional Done and all nested Ready; settled connects same result to actual final world.

observed uses the supplied actual root Cert and ThetaAt location, derives root Ready and all call inputs, then delegates to JournalCheckpoints.observed on the same tree/result. Local returned world, logs/observations and post-journal stay tied to the actual located call, including ancestor rollback. It does not claim local world equals final transaction world.
No per-call journal invariant, predicted child state, or all-node nofuel premise remains; initial invariant and independent numerical/protocol inputs remain explicit.
explicit_inputs: Initial JournalInvariant.Invariant kind budget c.world; canonical initialized history producer remains external.
FundingHistory.Trace initial credits c.world plus initial worldFunds+credits<fundingCeiling; credit provenance and cumulative ceiling not proved here.

TransactionFunding.Admission: actual sender account, natural upfront+value affordability, nonce<2^64-1, priority<=effective price. This is a sufficient pinned-evaluator input, not complete Ethereum admission.
Transaction data size<UInt256.size and root Nat fuel5*(entryGas+1)<=fuel.

completed: actual c.result.ok plus budget+used.toNat<2^128. observed: actual root Cert plus budget+tree.count<2^128, actual positive-fuel protected Theta location and completed local result; no successful transaction status required.
scope_limits: Linked initialized transaction histories, funding/issuance provenance, data/admission and protocol resource budget producers remain separate.
Existing pinned transaction variants do not establish reference Amsterdam set-code/delegation or dual-gas adequacy.
Evaluator fuel safety does not establish no OutOfGass or SYSTEM progress; no normative fork/inhibition decision is adopted.
Executed event work and local observations survive as proof facts for reverted ancestors, but committed-record/log-survival provenance is not established.
Three local observations include runtime control; no full protocol guarantee closure.
